svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Kafka producer: routing, topic creation, broker ack and failure boundaries

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Kafka producer: routing, topic creation, broker ack and failure boundaries
Core, Rule Engine and Transport providers create several
independent producer templates for fixed message channels.
Resolve and encode one Rule Engine message
hash(entity UUID) modulo logical partition count
build full topic with prefix, isolation and suffix
First send to a physical topic
capture up to 18 stack trace headers
select Kafka partition and append accumulator
The record is in Kafka according to acks.
Consumer, Actor, Rule Node and database work are still pending.
send(service-specific topic, same msgId, null callback)
Each send is independent. Partial broadcast success is possible,
and async failures with null callback are log-only.
but the shared Producer Provider classes do not call stop() in this release.
